intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Senna is searching her apron one labeled pocket at a time. She reaches *sweets, for patients* and stops.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “My spectacles. I put them somewhere safe. I remember being very pleased with myself.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Something small and wire-framed is perched on top of your head.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Oh. Yes. I put them on you. You were the only thing nearby that wasn’t going anywhere.”

options.labelText: “How do you lose things on your own head? Or, apparently, mine?”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She lifts them off your head and leaves. Your head feels noticeably colder.

options.labelText: “Here. Maybe pick one place for them and always use it?”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “One place. Yes. I did pick one.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She pushes them up onto her own head, where she’ll lose them again before you’ve finished talking.

options.labelText: “Leave them with me. I’ll guard them.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She goes back to her notes. Every so often she borrows them to read one line, then puts them back on your head.
